name: Pricing and Revenue Management
description: Dynamic pricing and revenue optimization, market segmentation, price differentiation, applications: airlines, e-commerce, railways, automobiles, internet pricing models, demand estimation, forecasting and learning: ARMA, ARIMA, exponential smoothing, dynamic regression models, capacity-based single resource revenue management, Littlewood’s model, computation approaches such as expected marginal seat revenue (EMSR), customer choice behaviour, revenue management systems set-up, capacity-based network revenue management, optimal network controls, optimization models and their limitations in solving network revenue management, approximations, heuristics, network revenue management systems, overbooking, dynamic pricing – single-product, multi-product, promotions optimization, auctions - types of auctions, independent private-value theory, game-theoretic analysis of auctions, revenue equivalence, optimization, learning and simulation-based techniques for revenue management.
